title: Siftly: app profiles, Azure Blob fidelity, Postgres 16 + pgvector (#43→#44→#46)
pr_body:
Rebuilds Rohith's Siftly stack on current main by cherry-picking #43, #44, #46 in order (authorship kept; source PRs untouched).

## Conflict resolutions
- `.gitignore`: main had no competing change; kept PR's new ignores.
- `cmd/vyomi/docker.go`: main added `wave2()` (second-wave startup) and the 'console starting' wording; #43 made the port dynamic. Kept both: `wave2()` + `c.simulatorPort()` in the message.
- `server.py`: main added `aws_elbv2`/`aws_logs` route modules; #43 added `app_env`. Kept all.
- `docs/specs/siftly-integration-gaps.md`: #43 edits a file that does not exist on main (deleted); kept main's state, edit dropped.

## Changes beyond the cherry-picks
- Reverted the PRs' `.github/workflows` edits (console-conformance build step, docker-publish postgres job): this lane may not edit `.github/`. **A person must add them**: build `packaging/postgres` multi-arch (amd64+arm64) and publish `vyomi/postgres:16-alpine-pgvector` (+ ghcr), and build it in the console-conformance workflow. Until it is published, `docker-compose.cloudlite.yml` (no `build:`) cannot pull the default image; `docker-compose.yml` builds locally. Multi-arch was NOT verified here (only a local amd64 build).
- `core/app_provision.py`: Service Bus provisioning imported `core.azure_servicebus_runtime`, which only exists in the separate Service Bus AMQP stack (#34→#45). Now uses it if present, else main's durable `PersistentMessagingStore` (VYOMI_AZSB_DB). Without the runtime module the router's live store won't see topics until reload.
- Regenerated `wasm/core/persistent_store.py` via `wasm/build_cores.py` (Nano mirror).

## Results (all green)
AE1-AE11 (run in simulator container), BL1-BL5 incl. Azurite, PG1-PG5 (compose stack with pgvector image), Azure SQL/Cloud SQL/GCS/RDS/RDS-data/pglite cores, `go test ./cmd/vyomi`, 34/34 offline Azure suites, RDS connectivity UI (offline+Nano), Azure storage console (Nano). Not run: the full AWS/GCP SDK/CLI matrix and Nano UI suites for Azure beyond storage.
